name: 89460 · Gardnerville, NV
findings: ZIP 89460 (Gardnerville) has 20 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (50%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 8 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 89460 (Gardnerville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 89460 (Gardnerville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 59% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 14 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
